Author: Minescence
Name: Fur Renderer
Description: Grows hundreds of thousands of skinned hair strands on any chosen item or minion based on their texture or material, and draws them with the GPU. Follows the dye and the scene's light. Only you see it.
Changelog: Fixed the fur trims turning into flat grey bands when seen from a distance (about 10 m and further). The fur now keeps the coat's shading at any distance, like it does up close.
